title: FLEX Research Requirements Document
text: The proposed experimental geometry uses a fuel droplet burning in a quiet, premixed ambient containing a gaseous suppressant. Approximate spherical symmetry helps isolate the roles of transport, radiation and chemical reactions near extinction. The design identifies droplet burning rate, extinction, flame radiation and soot characteristics as quantities relevant to evaluating models and suppression.
limitations: Design document. Planned diagnostics and variables do not establish that every flight run measured them.

title: NASA — You’re Hot Then You’re Cold
